stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 worktree [<subcommand>] [--] [<args>...]

Manage multiple working trees attached to a repository.

Subcommands:
    list                          List linked working trees
    add [--lock] [--force] <path> [<branch>]
                                  Add a new working tree
    lock <name> [reason]          Lock a worktree
    unlock <name>                 Unlock a worktree
    prune [--force] <name>        Prune a missing or invalid worktree

Options:
    <subcommand>
        the subcommand (list, add, lock, unlock, prune)
    <args>...
        arguments for the subcommand
